# Burning Springs: Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase Locations 61 to 79

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Nov 22, 2025
- 7 min read

Updated: Dec 3, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5158099d1e3447b29a5f2404e9527d95~mv2.jpg)

*****Subject to change pending porting to live servers*****

This route is meant to be run from

**61 to 79**

Some spawns are out of the way and rely on the previous spawn to reach the next one. I set the path up so you can grab the briefcases needed for the Abraxo weapons as fast as possible.

Each location has a tick box under it so you can mark them off as you go.

If you want the full list all on one page, use the

Burning Springs: Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase Rewards and Checklist

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 61**

Fast Travel Point:

- The Rust Kingdom

Directions:

From the spawn in location, run straight toward the flaming deathclaw gate and stop at the fire barrel on your left. Next to the barrel is a ramp leading up to the top of the gate. Jump up the ramp and head south, then jump over the wall. When you land on the other side, stop. Look down, face West, and the briefcase will be sitting right under your nose.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6c6bc3c66cb74871bd6dcedc380f0641~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 62**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face North, jump over the wall, and run forward. Veer left until you’re on the main road heading away from the gate. Follow the road until you reach the “Highway Town” billboard. Turn right and walk behind it. Face East and you’ll spot a raider cage on a tall pole. Head over to the pole and walk slowly past it. The briefcase will be on the ground on your left, half tucked into a wooden bookcase next to the silver oven.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a767830528e947a8a7137c93fa557b04~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 63**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, turn around and run back to the front of the billboard. Face West and you’ll see two more raider cages on poles across the road. Run straight over to them and stop at the pile of cages on the ground. The briefcase will be on your left, half buried under the air-conditioning duct.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9d1e59e8e3c74bcdabd73e08f8d9f5a4~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 64**

Fast Travel Point:

- Railroad Service Yard

Directions:

From the spawn in location, face South and you’ll see a cylinder train carriage ahead of you. Run over and jump onto the top of it. Keep moving across the carriages until you reach the small shed on your left. Veer left and go inside. The briefcase is on the metal shelf against the light blue shipping container.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e32bb941f0434f968dd9f6a894e07eeb~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 65**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face south and exit the shed through the door in front of you. Turn southwest and walk to the front of the orange train carriage. Press the button on the wall and wait for the door to open. Head inside and continue forward until you reach the skeleton covered in plants. Look up and jump onto the catwalk above. Turn right, walk forward a few steps, then turn right again. Enter the blue metal building and follow it to the end. The briefcase is on the desk next to the broken terminal.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c5c1299c8a0a44a582c124b363f5549d~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 66**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, turn around and follow the catwalk around, then drop back down to the skeleton covered in plants. Face northeast and walk to the blue door in the corner. Open it and break the boards blocking the way. Go down the stairs and stop at the bottom, then face East. Run and jump across to the brick building on the other side of the tracks. Don’t go inside. Instead, climb onto the roof above the door and face South. Walk through the hole in the wall and you’ll find the briefcase under the desk on your right.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9a406f0cd2bd4e9796d75dc84c150619~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 67**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, exit the building, face North, and run straight until you reach the last cylinder train carriage in the area, on your left. Turn toward the northeast and drop off the ledge as you walk forward. Go around the carriage until you find the entrance. Head inside, and the briefcase will be at the far end, next to the bed and the skeleton in the chair.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_461d26a7de70498aa55e9fd7f0137471~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 68**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, exit the carriage and jump onto the roof. Face West and run forward until you reach the train tracks. Turn northwest and follow the tracks, keeping an eye on the hill to your left. When you spot a gap in the hillside, turn left and head toward it. Go into the gap and you’ll find the briefcase on your right, next to a corpse.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e63ca101565d4f92a42929f51c20555f~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 69**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, turn around, leave the gap, and walk back to the train tracks. Turn left and follow the tracks until you see a blue canvas curtain on your left. Face West and walk over to the shelter. The briefcase is in the shopping trolley on your left, just outside the shelter.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_528390e0d2384441aa4875bb4e8cb4f6~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 70**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face southeast and run over to the train carriage. Jump up onto the green shipping container. Turn toward the northeast and walk forward until you reach a yellow dirt path. Face North and follow the path until you reach the tree blocking the way. The briefcase is under the fallen trunk.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_1c62b34457e44c4a884a16c8eecc0f32~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 71**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face North and look up. You’ll see a hill covered in statues of corn cobs. Head toward the hill and veer right, stopping at the bottom of the stairs on your right. Go up the stairs and follow the wooden path. Turn right and keep following the path to the end. Turn North and you’ll see the briefcase on the edge of the hole in front of you, near a green ammo bag and a corpse.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5d8bd8861006487ba87a65a4e890e65f~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 72**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face North and run to the white building in front of you. Go inside and turn left. Follow the room around and stop at the Employees Only door on your left. Open the door and go in. Walk around behind the desk, and the briefcase will be under it.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_97f8ea57158b4d01a009e226df1821bb~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 73**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

This briefcase does not exist in the game files.

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 74**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, exit the room and turn left. Walk out of the building and jump up onto the roof of the building. Face West and you will see a playground in the distance.

Run over to the playground and look for the skeleton going down the slide. The briefcase is under the slide, leaning against the wooden tower.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_bde68c29edd9462f83cea59872b36ebb~mv2.jpg)

The baseball bat on the ground here has a chance to spawn in a rare colour variant.

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 75**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face North and walk over to the main road. Turn northeast and follow the road until the water tower comes into view on your left. Run over to it and stop at the small shed at the base of the tower. Go inside through the white door. The briefcase is on the ground, leaning against the desk along the southern wall.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8e2f7bc74ccb4af89b7314099f222e7a~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 76**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, exit the shed and jump up onto the roof. Face northwest and you’ll spot a yellow dirt path leading uphill toward a farm, with grain silos visible on your right. Head to the dirt path and follow it all the way up to the farm. When you arrive, walk over to the shorter grain silo in front of you. The briefcase is sitting on a pile of pallets at the base of the silo.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_40996c4168944564bfac25e8c4aa3eae~mv2.jpg)

Reward Unlocked: Meadow Breeze Sprayer

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6c7947f50b6b4feabade3e239bd4b992~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 77**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

This briefcase does not exist in the game files.

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 78**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, look to your left for the red barn with the chained-shut door. Jump onto the roof of the barn and face northwest. Keep your line as straight as possible and run forward until you reach a rusty blue ute/pickup truck. Walk through the gap between the rock and the ute, then continue straight ahead. The briefcase is on the ground at the base of the tree on your right.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d7c6d350a0ec4936b878082d538dcb22~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 79**

Fast Travel Point:

- Honey Well Apiary

Directions:

From the spawn in location, turn west and cross the wooden bridge. Follow the yellow dirt path and take the right-hand path when it splits. Continue up the path to the shed. Do not go inside. The briefcase is leaning against the right-hand side of the shed, in the garden bed.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5f0c3d4c0ade49c398bdab5d4e745967~mv2.jpg)
